pdf2text.drop: Drop a PDF here or click to choose one
pdf2text.label.range: Page range — leave empty for all (e.g. 1-3, 5)
pdf2text.ph.out: The extracted text shows up here
pdf2text.status.idle: The file stays in your browser — the document is never uploaded.
pdf2text.err.lib: Could not load the PDF engine
pdf2text.say.opened: Set a page range and hit extract.
pdf2text.err.range: No pages match that range. This PDF has {n} pages, so stay inside it (e.g. 1-3, 5).
pdf2text.err.scanned: This PDF has no text — it looks like a scan of paper. This tool cannot read letters out of an image.
pdf2text.say.someEmpty: Extracted {chars} characters. {empty} page(s) had no text though (they may be images or scans).
